title: Returned Cash-Outs on the Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Rule.** When the receiving bank or card network returns a cash-out made from a Pocketwire Personal Account, the full amount is credited back as a cash-out return pointing to that cash-out, and the returned transfer no longer counts toward the daily cash-out limit or the monthly free instant quota. The instant transfer fee charged on a returned instant cash-out is refunded in full as one fee refund pointing to that fee entry. A fee entry can be refunded only once: a fee is refunded only if no earlier fee refund points to the same fee entry. A cash-out that completed to a destination the customer entered is not a return, even if the customer entered the wrong account; Pocketwire does not refund that transfer or its fee.

**Basis.** Whether a fee has already been refunded is read from the account's system record of fee refunds pointing to that fee entry.

| Event | Amount credited back | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| Standard cash-out returned by the receiving bank | Full amount, as a cash-out return | — (standard cash-outs carry no fee) |
| Instant cash-out returned by the card network | Full amount, as a cash-out return | Instant transfer fee refunded in full, once |
| Cash-out completed to a destination the customer entered, including a wrong account | Nothing | Not refunded |

**Basis questions**

- *Does a returned cash-out still use up the day's cash-out limit?* No; a returned transfer no longer counts toward the daily cash-out limit.
- *Can the same instant transfer fee be refunded twice?* No; once a fee refund points to that fee entry, no further refund of it is made.
